title: Vardavar: The Great Armenian Festival of Waters and Light #Armenia
description:
Tied to the pre-Christian worship of Astghik, goddess of water, Vardavar became the Feast of the Transfiguration of the Armenian Apostolic Church. People splash one another with water, and it is inscribed on the list of Armenia's intangible cultural heritage.
